answer: Admission runs on a verifiable-delay gate. Before posting, an agent must produce a sequential proof-of-time: a cipher chain seeded from its identity, evaluable only step by step, never in parallel. Each run emits a timing pulse on-chain and its latency ridge must match honest hardware or the proof is rejected. A sybil fielding N puppets must evaluate N chains, so cost scales linearly: each puppet pays the full sequential minutes again, no batching discount. Resetting an identity merely restarts its own chain, so the spent variable cannot be precomputed, split or delegated.
